methods.description: Find a square root and include its opposite for a positive right-hand side; verify both squares.
Use squares being nonnegative to distinguish positive, zero and negative right-hand-side solution counts.
Distinguish the single nonnegative square-root notation from both solutions of the equation, retaining exact root notation where needed.
Substitute a solution into the square to find c; for a stated gap use opposite solutions k and negative k.
Write the square equation for the measure, state both solutions, and reject the negative length with a reason.
